import axiosInstance from"core/services/api/axiosInstance";const base_url=process.env.REACT_APP_API_URL;const API_URL=`${base_url}approval-work-flows`;// Get Data
const getApprovalWorkflows=async access_token=>{const config={headers:{Authorization:`Bearer ${access_token}`}};const response=await axiosInstance.get(API_URL,config);return response.data;};// Create 
const createApprovalWorkflow=async(approvalWorkflowData,token)=>{const config={headers:{Authorization:`Bearer ${token}`}};const response=await axiosInstance.post(API_URL,approvalWorkflowData,config);return response.data;};// update
const updateApprovalWorkflow=async(approvalWorkflowId,approvalWorkflowData,token)=>{const config={headers:{Authorization:`Bearer ${token}`}};const response=await axiosInstance.put(API_URL+'/'+approvalWorkflowId,approvalWorkflowData,config);return response.data;};// Delete 
const deleteApprovalWorkflow=async(approvalWorkflowId,token)=>{const config={headers:{Authorization:`Bearer ${token}`}};const response=await axiosInstance.delete(API_URL+'/'+approvalWorkflowId,config);return response.data;};const approvalWorkflowService={getApprovalWorkflows,createApprovalWorkflow,updateApprovalWorkflow,deleteApprovalWorkflow};export default approvalWorkflowService;
